about: An item's name shows whole in a mart's list: Cherrygrove's EV/IV trainer's shop (route29-official.sav, given 30000), Buy Mochi and Caps, RIGHT twice to the list's second page, where the Fresh-Start Mochi is. The cell's window is 88 pixels wide and the name 97 in the system font: printed in it, 'Fresh-Start Moc' was cut at the window's edge and gDiagItemNameCut reads 9; it goes in the narrow font (PrintItemNameInCell) and reads 0.
